newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bonn sets 4.50 pct coupon for series-123 Bobl-Buba.
newsitem.headline: Bonn sets 4.50 pct coupon for series-123 Bobl-Buba.

text.p: The German federal government set a 4.50 percent coupon on its new series-123 five-year Bundesobligation, or Bobl, the Bundesbank as issuing agent said on Tuesday.
The new series will carry an initial price of 99.55 to yield 4.60 percent, the central bank said.
The Bundesbank also repeated that it would auction about 10 billion marks of its series-122 Bobl on May 21.
